meta.title: The buyer's surrogate bid upload for BOQ
gaps: Reach or create the specified live BOQ stage because BOQ line items require a sheet upload that no catalog step can perform.
Verify the ON/OFF behavior of the unspecified tenant settings boq_in_erfx_allowed and is_bid_sheet_upload_enabled.
Open the BOQ surrogate-bid drawer and assert Upload Excel is present or absent.
Download the BOQ bid template and verify the exact GET /v1/trade/<stage>/download_event_details?company_uuid=… request.
Upload a filled .xlsx or .xls file, verify extension validation, assert the POST /v1/trade/<stage>/upload_bid_excel request, and check Excel Uploaded Successfully.
Verify prices populate without placing a bid, then click Place bid and assert Bid placed on behalf of <vendor>.
Compare bid count before and after the upload and placement.
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`

steps.note: Closest available entry point to a published event's buyer-side Participants screen, but the prepared state is a pricing event rather than the specified BOQ stage.
Reaches the participant list where a buyer-side surrogate Add Bid control can be observed, but this does not expose the requested BOQ upload flow.
